item.title: Lil Durk Is Found Not Guilty in Murder-for-Hire Case

item.title: Nashville Says Yes to Renaming Airport for Dolly Parton
item.description: A board voted unanimously to honor the country star, philanthropist and Tennessee native. If the effort clears all hurdles, fliers will be “departin’ from Parton.”
item.dc:creator: Christine Chung
item.media:description: The effort to rename Nashville International Airport for Dolly Parton cleared a major hurdle on Friday. If successful, it will make the airport one of the few in major U.S. cities named for a woman.

item.title: A.I. Music Giant Suno Tries to Play Nice With Record Labels

item.title: Justin Vivian Bond, Cabaret Chanteuse, Left New York for Paris. New York Called Her Back.
item.description: Justin Vivian Bond, a cabaret performer and MacArthur “genius,” left New York to move to Paris. Now she’s back at Joe’s Pub to tell us all about it.
item.dc:creator: Jada Yuan
item.media:credit: Meghan Marin for The New York Times
item.media:description: “I don’t know any other singer or cabaret performer that does five individual, distinct shows a year,” said Sammy Jo, Bond’s best friend. “I think that’s how she keeps her brain from atrophying.”
